title: Shard thousands of feet tall beside a Martian impact crater
summary: Joe McMoneagle tells of Shard thousands of feet tall beside a Martian impact crater, about unspecified at Mars, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: that's not a pyramid That's A Shard and it's thousands of feet tall

plain: Joe McMoneagle, who says he was trained as a remote viewer, someone who tries to see distant places using only the mind, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about photo negatives from the mapping of Mars by JPL, NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory. He says that beside an impact crater on Mars there is an object he says is not a pyramid but a shard, thousands of feet tall. He tells it because, if true, Mars once held life that built things.
